class.name: OcgPrsdimSymmetricrelation
class.brief_description: A framework to display constraints of symmetricity between two or more datum Interactive Objects. A plane serves as the axis of symmetry between the shapes of which the datums are parts.
class.description: ! A framework to display constraints of symmetricity ! between two or more datum Interactive Objects. ! A plane serves as the axis of symmetry between the ! shapes of which the datums are parts.

method.name: SetTool
method.description: Sets the tool aSymmetricTool composed of a first shape, a second shape, and a plane. This tool is initially created at construction time.

method.name: GetTool
method.description: Returns the tool composed of a first shape, a second shape, and a plane. This tool is created at construction time.
